info.title: EyeWall API
info.description:
Hockey models built by [EyeWall Analytics](https://eyewallanalytics.com) for the NHL, PWHL, AHL and ECHL: Elo ratings, pre-game win probabilities, playoff odds, power rankings, player percentiles, projected lines, starting-goalie probabilities and a public scorecard of how the models have done; and NHL contracts from EyeWall's open [nhl-contracts](https://github.com/ehlersio/nhl-contracts) dataset.

**What's here.** Only numbers EyeWall produces, and the contracts dataset EyeWall collects. Box scores, play-by-play, rosters, standings and schedules belong to the leagues and aren't served here; responses carry league ids and team codes so you can join to those feeds yourself.

**Licence.** Data is [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): credit "EyeWall Analytics (eyewallanalytics.com)" wherever it appears. The exception is NHL models built on [MoneyPuck](https://moneypuck.com) inputs (WAR, NHL power rankings, team needs, trade fit, and EyeWall AI's NHL text): those are [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/), non-commercial only, crediting MoneyPuck.com as well. NHL contracts are [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) (no credit required), like the dataset they come from. Each response's `meta.license` and `meta.attribution` say exactly what applies. Code is MIT ([github.com/ehlersio/eyewall-api](https://github.com/ehlersio/eyewall-api)).

**Limits.** 60 requests a minute per IP, no key needed. Responses are cached; most data changes once a night.

**Stability.** `/v1` only changes by adding things. A breaking change gets a `/v2`, and `/v1` keeps working for at least a full season after.

Probabilities are model estimates, not betting odds.

tags.name: Contracts
tags.description: NHL contracts from EyeWall's open [nhl-contracts](https://github.com/ehlersio/nhl-contracts) dataset: **CC0**, no credit required. Every number is tied to the public document it came from; `tier` says what kind of document (A club release on NHL.com, B NHL.com staff story, C ESPN's transaction wire, D PuckPedia's public posts or insiders quoted on r/hockey, E CapFriendly as archived by the Internet Archive). Where sources disagree the field is null and named in `conflicts`, never resolved. The per-source claims, with the sentence each number came from, are in the dataset's release files. Refreshed nightly.

idSource.description: Where the league's team, game and player ids come from.

League.description: League id. NHL ids come from the NHL; PWHL, AHL and ECHL ids are HockeyTech ids.

source.description: Which EyeWall model or table the data comes from.

attribution.description: Credit line to show wherever the data appears.

generatedAt.description: When EyeWall produced this data (ISO 8601 date or timestamp), null when unknown.

allOf.description: PWHL only: the next regular season once it is scheduled. Null otherwise.

seasons.description: Seasons EyeWall has team data for, newest first.

CurrentSeason.description: The season EyeWall treats as current. For the PWHL this is the latest regular season until the next one starts.

SeasonType.description: HockeyTech season type. Null for the NHL, whose season id covers preseason, regular season and playoffs (game type is per game).

id.description: League team id (NHL team id, or HockeyTech team id).

homeAdvantage.description: Elo points added to the home team.

formula.example: P(home win) = 1 / (1 + 10^((awayRating - (homeRating + homeAdvantage)) / 400)); no home advantage at a neutral site

ratings.description: Current teams with a rating, highest first. A team with no games in EyeWall's replay yet (e.g. an expansion team before its first game) is left out.

gameType.description: NHL only; null for PWHL/AHL/ECHL (see the season's type).

loggedOn.description: The morning (America/New_York) the probability was logged. The last pre-game log is kept, and is what EyeWall's public scorecard grades.

GameTeam.description: A team in a game. Fields are null only for a team that is no longer current (e.g. relocated).

runDate.description: The nightly run these numbers come from.

stale.description: True when the latest run is older than expected (the nightly job missed a run).

format.description: PWHL/AHL/ECHL: the playoff format the simulation used, or "unverified".

playoffProbability.description: Share of simulations in which the team makes the playoffs. Null when the league hasn't published this season's playoff format.

divisionProbability.description: Share of simulations in which the team wins its division. Null where the format has no division title.

projectedPoints.description: Final standings points across the simulations.

eloRating.description: NHL only: the rating the simulation started from.

models.description: Keyed by model: gameWinner, startingGoalie, playoffOdds.

status.description: "ok", or "pending" before there is anything to grade.

baseline.description: A naive rule to beat, scored on the same predictions.

recent.description: The latest graded predictions (live grades only).

rapm.description: Expected-goal differential per 60 minutes at 5-on-5 above an average player, from a ridge regression over three seasons of shots and shifts.

players.description: Highest first. Players under 150 minutes in the sample are left out.

narrative.description: EyeWall AI's paragraph on the ranking (English).

history.description: Up to 28 recent runs this season, oldest first.

basis.description: The lineup the slots come from: "last_game" or "preseason". Null before the first projection.

rating.description: WAR per 82 games. Null when unrated (too few games this season and last).

need.description: True for the bottom third of the league in this slot.

rating.description: WAR per 82 games for a skater. Null for a goalie (MoneyPuck's own goals saved above expected).

rental.description: True for an expiring contract during the season.

clause.description: "NMC", "NTC" or similar; null for none or unknown.

phase.description: "offseason" from the day after the trade deadline: the fit is then for next season.

slot.description: The lineup slot the player would fill.

gap.description: How much the player would improve that slot, in rating units.

windowMet.description: For a rental: the team is a likely playoff buyer (50%+ playoff odds).

reasons.description: Structured reasons: each has a `code` (need_upgrade, need_depth, window_term, cap_fits, cap_fits_retained, cap_fits_ltir, cap_needs_salary, …) and the numbers behind it.

teams.description: Every other team, best fit first.

allOf.description: The side the recap is written for.

cardText.description: A one-line version for cards and notifications.

history.description: Every contract the dataset has for the player, newest first.

id.description: NHL player id; null when no source gave or matched one.

ContractSourceTier.description: A club release on NHL.com, B NHL.com staff story, C ESPN transaction wire, D PuckPedia's public posts or insiders quoted on r/hockey, E archived CapFriendly page.

listSize.description: For a modified clause: the number of teams on the list, when stated.

listType.description: "no-trade" (teams he cannot be traded to) or "approved", when stated.

status.description: "clause": a no-move or no-trade clause applies; "none": a source says there is none; "none_likely": none reported where one would be; "unknown".

basis.description: What the status rests on: "source", "stated", "capfriendly_2024", "ineligible" or "breakdown_without_clause".

key.description: The dataset's contract_key: NHL player id (or normalized name) | signing team | signing month. Null on /v1/nhl/contracts for a roster player the dataset has no contract for.

signingTeam.description: Code of the team that signed the contract, as it was then (ARI for the Coyotes). A player traded since keeps it.

signedAt.description: Signing date when a source states it, else the date the deal was first published.

endSeason.description: Last season of the contract (for a bought-out deal, the last season before the buyout).

yearsLeft.description: Seasons left after the requested one (history: after the current season).

capHit.description: Cap hit in USD for the requested season (history: the contract's stated cap hit or AAV). Null when no source states one.

capHitBasis.description: Where capHit comes from: the season breakdown, the contract's stated cap hit, or its AAV.

oneWay.description: True one-way, false two-way, null not stated.

expiryTypeDerived.description: True when expiryType was worked out from age and service rules rather than stated by a source.

current.description: The dataset marks the contract as running now.

endSeasonSigned.description: For a bought-out contract: the season it was signed to run through.

allOf.description: Best source tier behind the contract.

official.description: True when the best source is tier A-C (club, NHL.com or ESPN).

conflicts.description: Fields the sources disagree on (left null rather than picked), e.g. ["aav_usd"].

minorsSalary.description: AHL salary of a two-way season.

clause.description: Clause label for the season as the source writes it.

rosterKnown.description: False when the NHL roster could not be read: then only deals the team signed are listed.

onRoster.description: On the team's current NHL roster. False: a deal the team signed whose player is elsewhere now.

alternates.description: Other rows the dataset holds for the same deal (an id-keyed and an archived name-keyed row, say); this one was chosen by tier and source count.

contracts.description: One contract per player: everyone on the current roster, then deals the team signed whose player is elsewhere (`onRoster` false). Cap hit descending.

status.description: Why: older rows only, mentioned but not parsed, or absent from every source.

missing.description: Roster players the dataset has no contract figure for.

deadCap.description: Buyout charges and retained salary the team carries this season; null when unreadable.

capSpaceEstimate.description: Ceiling minus the roster cap hit, dead cap and LTIR players missing from the roster list. An estimate, not cap space: `estimateNotes` says what it leaves out (no_ltir, no_bonus_overages, no_recapture, partial_coverage).

counterparty.description: For retained salary: the team the player was traded to, when stated.

pct.description: Share of salary retained, when stated.

CapLimits.description: The NHL's announced cap ceiling, floor and minimum salary for the season; null when not announced.

ExpiringCounts.description: Contracts ending after the season, by status at expiry.

capHitTotal.description: Sum of their cap hits: an upper bound on relief, not the relief.

offRosterCapHit.description: Cap hits of LTIR players missing from the NHL's roster list, which the estimate still counts.

LtirSummary.description: Active long-term injured reserve. Null when the LTIR table could not be read.

since.description: Placement date when a source states it.

firstSeen.description: First day the dataset saw him on long-term IR.

statedRelief.description: LTIR relief as PuckPedia stated it, when it did.

teamsKnown.description: Teams whose roster was read (32 when complete).

key.description: The dataset's contract_key: NHL player id (or normalized name) | signing team | signing month. Null on /v1/nhl/contracts for a roster player the dataset has no contract for.

signingTeam.description: Code of the team that signed the contract, as it was then (ARI for the Coyotes). A player traded since keeps it.

signedAt.description: Signing date when a source states it, else the date the deal was first published.

endSeason.description: Last season of the contract (for a bought-out deal, the last season before the buyout).

yearsLeft.description: Seasons left after the requested one (history: after the current season).

capHit.description: Cap hit in USD for the requested season (history: the contract's stated cap hit or AAV). Null when no source states one.

capHitBasis.description: Where capHit comes from: the season breakdown, the contract's stated cap hit, or its AAV.

oneWay.description: True one-way, false two-way, null not stated.

expiryTypeDerived.description: True when expiryType was worked out from age and service rules rather than stated by a source.

current.description: The dataset marks the contract as running now.

endSeasonSigned.description: For a bought-out contract: the season it was signed to run through.

allOf.description: Best source tier behind the contract.

official.description: True when the best source is tier A-C (club, NHL.com or ESPN).

conflicts.description: Fields the sources disagree on (left null rather than picked), e.g. ["aav_usd"].

currentTeam.description: Code of the roster the player is on now (signingTeam may differ).

players.description: Every player on an NHL roster today or with a contract covering the season, cap hit descending, figures first. No clauses (see the player route).

teamsKnown.description: basis=roster: teams whose roster was read.

contracts.description: basis=signing_team: contracts the team signed that cover the season.

capHitTotal.description: basis=signing_team: cap hits of those contracts.

capSpaceEstimate.description: basis=roster. Ceiling minus the roster cap hit, dead cap and LTIR players missing from the roster list. An estimate, not cap space: `estimateNotes` says what it leaves out (no_ltir, no_bonus_overages, no_recapture, partial_coverage).

season.description: The season asked for; null when none was given (the latest run).

teams.description: Best first. Empty before the season's first run.

previousRank.description: Rank in the previous run; null on a team's first run.

PowerRankingComponentRanks.description: League rank (1 = best) in each part of the score: pts_pct (points percentage), l10_pts_pct (last 10 games), gd_pg (goal difference per game), special_teams.

season.description: The season asked for; null when none was given (the latest run).

allOf.description: Null before the season's first run.

narrative.description: EyeWall AI's paragraph on the team's ranking, in the requested language. Null when none was written for this run.

history.description: This season's recent runs, oldest first (up to 28).

rateBasis.description: What the rates are per, e.g. "perGP" (per game played) where the league publishes no ice time.

percentiles.description: Keyed by stat: goals, a1 (primary assists), penalties, finishing.

percentile.description: 0-100 rank against the league pool. Null when the player is below the sample floor or the stat has no data.

rateBasis.description: What the rates are per, e.g. "perGP" (per game played) where the league publishes no ice time.

goalsSavedAboveExpected.description: From EyeWall's danger-zone xG on the shots faced.

savePercentage.description: Save percentage by situation and danger zone, 0-100.

percentiles.description: Keyed by stat: gsax, gsax60, evSv, hdSv, mdSv, pkSv.

basis.description: "last_game": the last game's pairings, adjusted for who is out. "preseason": pooled preseason pairings before a team's first game. Null when there is no projection yet.

forwardLines.description: Left wing, center, right wing; top line first.

filledIn.description: True for a player who wasn't in the lineup the projection is based on (replacing an injured or moved player): the least certain part.

teams.description: Each team's goalies, most likely starter first.
